title: Figures 5-6: GW flux growth in stacks of N orbital planes and circular waveguide plates
description: Two side-by-side diagrams of four stacked planes labeled N=1 to N=4 with a red GW axis passing vertically through them and growing loops at each level. Figure 5, "GW Flux Growth Analogous to Stack of N Orbital Planes", shows orbiting masses with Δf arrows; Figure 6, "Stack of Circular-Wave-Guide Plates With Typical Molecule Jerks, Δf's", replaces the orbits with blue circular waveguide rings. Text calculates IR ring waveguide parameters and HFGW flux.
